title: Alternatives to Shallow Autoencoders for Collaborative Filtering
abstract: arXiv:2611.06610v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Collaborative filtering (CF) is a cornerstone of recommender systems and plays a relevant role in many modern applications. CF uses user-item interaction data to discover future preferences. Although deep learning models have shown promise in CF, Embarrassingly Shallow Autoencoders for Sparse Data (EASE) has gained attention for its outstanding ranking accuracy provided by its closed-form solution. EASE relies primarily on relationships among items to fit a full-rank high-dimensional linear mapping. We hypothesize that this design limits its capacity to capture similar but not equivalent fine-grained user relationships, consequently limiting its recommendation accuracy. translated_title: 协同过滤中浅层自编码器的替代方案
translated_abstract: 协同过滤（CF）是推荐系统的基石，在许多现代应用中发挥着重要作用。CF利用用户-物品交互数据来发现用户的未来偏好。尽管深度学习模型在协同过滤中展现出了潜力，但面向稀疏数据的极简浅层自编码器（EASE）因其闭式解所带来的出色排序准确性而备受关注。EASE主要依靠物品之间的关系来拟合一个满秩的高维线性映射。我们假设这种设计限制了其捕捉相似但不完全等价的细粒度用户关系的能力，从而限制了其推荐准确性。本文提出了一种基于EASE的替代公式，该公式利用了用户-用户之间的信息。此外，我们提出了一个同时结合用户-用户和物品-物品邻接分布的混合模型。我们的实验表明，所提出的模型表现更优。
tldr: 该论文针对EASE模型仅依赖物品-物品关系而限制细粒度用户关系捕捉的问题，提出了利用用户-用户信息的替代模型，以及结合用户-用户和物品-物品邻接分布的混合模型，从而提升协同过滤的推荐准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes alternatives to EASE that leverage user-user information, along with a hybrid model combining both user-user and item-item adjacency distributions, to improve recommendation accuracy in collaborative filtering.
